QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_18

answer.text: Unlisted companies with established business model and track record, often including buy-outs

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 18 and 32 of the source explain that Private Equity primarily targets unlisted or later-stage companies that already have an established business model and track record, and page 18 supports the inclusion of buyouts/LBOs as part of PE activity. The Trap: PE is not restricted to listed stocks, bonds, or commodities — those narrow descriptions miss the unlisted-company and buy-out focus that distinguishes PE from VC (which targets earlier-stage businesses). Note: Under SEBI's AIF framework, PE funds are placed in Category II AIF (pages 35-36).
